ECON-101.name: Principles of Microeconomics
ECON-101.description: Studies how consumer demand, producer supply and market competition determine outcomes in individual markets.
notes: No separate prerequisite field was displayed; this does not establish unrestricted enrollment.

category_review.locator: ECON-101 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
category_review.rationale: The description teaches substantive economic behavior and market theory, not general mathematical methods.

ECON-201.name: Principles of Macroeconomics
ECON-201.description: Studies aggregate economic behavior through production possibilities, inflation, employment, growth, national accounts, monetary roles and macroeconomic models.
ECON-201.prerequisites: ECON-101 or completion of one (1) 400 or 500 level ECON course.

category_review.locator: ECON-201 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
category_review.rationale: Economic mechanisms and domain models organize the course.

ECON-401.name: Intermediate Microeconomic Theory
ECON-401.description: Develops economic tools for resource allocation through consumer behavior, production, costs and market structures.
ECON-401.prerequisites: ECON-101 or completion of one (1) 400 or 500 level ECON course and MATH-161 or MATH-171 or MATH-181 or MATH-181A or equivalent courses.
notes: The published prerequisite field lacks complete Boolean parentheses. Its literal conjunctions and alternatives are preserved, not resolved into a guessed enrollment rule.

category_review.locator: ECON-401 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
category_review.rationale: The explicit subject is economic allocation theory; a calculus prerequisite does not make it mathematics.

ECON-402.name: Intermediate Macroeconomic Theory
ECON-402.description: Develops models of output, employment and prices, comparing major macroeconomic theories and policy in historical and global contexts.
ECON-402.prerequisites: ECON-101 or completion of one (1) 400 or 500 level ECON course and ECON-201 and (MATH-161 or MATH-171 or MATH-181 or MATH-181A) or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: ECON-402 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
category_review.rationale: Domain economic theory and modeling are central; policy and history provide context.

ECON-403.name: Econometrics I
ECON-403.description: Develops applied regression skills including estimation, data preparation, interpretation and misuse, for cross-sectional and time-series data.
ECON-403.prerequisites: (ECON-101 or ECON-101H) and (MATH-161 or MATH-171 or 1016-171T or MATH-181 or MATH-181A) and (STAT-145 or CQAS-251 or MATH-251 or STAT-205 or STAT-251) or equivalent courses.
notes: The prerequisite field prints historical code 1016-171T; it is preserved without inferring an identity or current availability.

category_review.locator: ECON-403 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
category_review.rationale: Statistical regression methods are the explicit focus.

ECON-404.name: Mathematical Methods: Economics
ECON-404.description: Introduces matrix algebra, multivariable calculus and constrained and unconstrained optimization through economic examples.
ECON-404.prerequisites: ECON-101 and MATH-161 or MATH-171 or MATH-181 or MATH-181A or equivalent courses.
notes: The published prerequisite field lacks complete Boolean parentheses; no precedence or eligibility is invented.

category_review.locator: ECON-404 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
category_review.rationale: Instruction centers on quantitative mathematical techniques.

ECON-405.name: International Trade and Finance
ECON-405.description: Examines comparative advantage, trade policy and welfare, trading institutions, national accounts, payments and exchange rates.
ECON-405.prerequisites: ECON-101 or completion of one (1) 400 or 500 level ECON course and ECON-201 or equivalent course.

category_review.locator: ECON-405 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
category_review.rationale: International economic theory and financial mechanisms determine the category.

ECON-406.name: Global Economic Issues

category_review.locator: ECON-406 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion

ECON-407.name: Industrial Organization

category_review.locator: ECON-407 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion

category_review.locator: ECON-410 / complete public popup / 2026–2027 economics immersion
